description: Jest 30.5.2's babel coverage provider on Track 8 F9's sample, rebuilt (T8.10, B23b): five modules under src/ (edge.ts with a `return -1` after a call that always throws, default parameters and `istanbul ignore next`/`else` hints; untested.ts, which no test imports; pricing.ts, cart.ts and format.ts) and 17 tests in tests/. `collectCoverageFrom: ['src/**/*.ts']`, so the untested file is reported with every counter at zero. The reports `json`, `json-summary`, `text`, `lcov` and `clover` are recorded as Jest wrote them (the work directory as `<root>`, clover's timestamps and Istanbul's per-file `hash`, a digest that holds the work directory's path, masked; Istanbul's maps sorted by path), and so is `--json`'s `coverageMap`. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage.test.ts`.
